titleEn: Stop, Look, One Step at a Time!

pages.text: "I'll cross first!" Yuki ran to the stream. Overnight rain had raised the water. One stepping stone was half submerged.
"I can cross myself! I'll wait on the other side!" Yuki hopped onto the first stone. Grandma put down her basket and followed.
Yuki stretched a foot to jump over two stones at once. Grandma caught Yuki's hand tightly. "Wait!"
Held in place, Yuki saw the half-submerged stone sliding with the current. Their heart thumped. A jump could have sent them into the water. Brown dog Momo whined at the bank.
Grandma looked into Yuki's eyes. "High water hides stones. One, stop before the stone!" Yuki nodded. "What next?"
"Two, check whether the stones are above water! Three, hold my hand and take one step at a time!" Yuki clenched both hands. "Stop, Look, One Step at a Time!"

Yuki stopped before the stones, passing over the submerged one and choosing only dry stones. Holding Grandma's hand, Yuki took one step, then another. Water babbled just below. "Stop, Look, One Step at a Time!"
Both feet reached the far bank! "I crossed by myself!" Yuki raised both arms. Grandma clapped beside them.
Yuki led on the way back, tightening the scarf knot again. "One, stop! Two, look at the stones! Three, hold Grandma's hand, one step at a time!"
Grandma carried Yuki home on her back. "You're so dependable." However hurried, stopping came first at the water. Yuki shook their wet feet. "Stop, Look, One Step at a Time!"
